English Language Requirements for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Programmes
English Language Requirements for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Programmes
Alongside meeting the academic entry requirements, all students must also meet the minimum English language entry requirements for their chosen programme in order to study at Queen Mary University of London.
The English language requirements for our programmes are indicated by English bands, and therefore the specific test and score acceptable is based on the band assigned to the academic department within which your chosen course of study is administered.
Below are our academic departments and the English bands assigned to them. Note that for some academic departments there are programmes with non-standard English language requirements.
Degree programmes that are jointly run by two academic departments will follow the English band requirements of the ‘Home’ department.
See English Language requirements for our Foundation courses, Pre-Masters programmes, Masters with Integrated Pre-Masters programmes, and Study Abroad Programmes.
School of the Arts
The English Language requirements for entry to programmes in the School of the Arts falls within the following English bands:
Undergraduate Programmes
Band 5: IELTS (Academic) minimum score 7.0 overall with 6.0 in each of Writing, Listening, Reading and Speaking
Postgraduate Taught and Research Programmes
MA Creative Arts and Media;
MA Digital Media and Global Cultures;
MA Linguistics
MA Linguistics and AI
MA Teaching English to Speaks of Other Languages (TESOL)
Band 4: IELTS (Academic) minimum score 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each of Writing, Listening, Reading and Speaking
All other postgraduate programmes not listed above:
Band 5: IELTS (Academic) minimum score 7.0 overall with 6.0 in each of Writing, Listening, Reading and Speaking
See all accepted English tests that we deem equivalent to these IELTS scores.
If you fall below our standard English Language requirements, you may consider one of our Pre-sessional English courses. See Pre-sessional English course requirements.
